shot_sound_cues.sound_prompt: Start a continuously phase-stable sine at 0.500 s; layer distant utensils, room air and indistinct conversation just before 3.000 s. No melody, impact, or electronic startup sound.

Seven-second market ambience cycle begins at absolute 3.0 s: bowls, food friction, steps and indistinct conversation. Phase continues across cuts while active. Persistent low sine remains beneath; no metered percussion.

Market ambience retreats as a distant acoustic memory; introduce isolated soft original piano tone and low room resonance. Separate droplet contact from delayed reflection cue. Leave acoustic decay crossing into S04.
Continue S03 decay; add minute electrical crackle and wire resonance; place second isolated original motif pitch. Sink water from S05 begins underneath final tail.
Start eleven-second maintenance ambience phase at 16 s: running water, ceramic on metal, gloves, ventilation. Third isolated motif tone enters very softly. Let ripple decay cross into S06.

Start five-second compute/cooling phase at 20 s, maintained thereafter without phase reset. Foreground paper and contacts are irregular, background cooling a steady note. Fourth fragmentary original motif note may appear; no resolved tune.

Start separate thirteen-second environmental phase at 24 s. Cool-air noise from S06 becomes ambiguous desert wind; weak structural vibration, not epic desert score. Air continues as ventilation under S08.

Exterior S07 wind becomes enclosed ventilation. Separate human claps enter at slightly different times and spatial locations, with faint unresolved low note. Last clap decay passes into S09 fan/urban sound.
S08 last clap echoes into rain and small fan whir; original fictional voice becomes indistinct under rotating air noise. Metallic fan resonance leads into S10 mesh.

Thin metallic residue from S09; quiet mesh slide, fabric and small door contact. Intentional interruption of any unfinished short piano-like tail here (exception to natural decay). Metallic contact becomes S11 actuator.
Reuse five-second compute phase from S06, without reset. Convey actuators, belt and air as layered physically timed sounds; droplet falls outside machine rhythm. Thin overtone moves into S12.
S11 high metallic resonance leads into dry cord friction and near-empty room. Cable's small inharmonic tail is transformed by editing into S13 piano mechanism, not thriller score.

Original wind, swollen wood, quiet key mechanism and unstable overtone, NOT a recognizable piano melody. Mechanical after-sound carries into S14 applause—a deliberate contrast between failed tone and abundant acclaim.

S13 imperfect key resonance underneath location-distant original claps, independently located balcony/empty-stage responses. Room decay outlasts bodies. Acoustic claps crossfade into S15 wood and textile shuttle sounds.

S14 applause tail becomes textile and wood contact. Two internally different phrases can loosely refer to 7 and 13 second phases, but use local clipped fragments only. Do not restart global sound loops on shot boundary.

Transform textile phases into two kinetic pathways: mechanical motor regularity vs footsteps/breath/suitcase-wheels variation. Human-route ambience may reference eleven-second family while current phase continues. All layers accumulate into S17.

Highest concurrent sound density, not highest loudness: extant 7/11/5/13/19/17 second phase families masked/unmasked independently, never restart. Incomplete original motif fragments and sine below. At 63.700 s stop every independent environmental/tonal loop on single master cut, not by waiting for alignment.

At 63.700s simultaneously stop six phase-independent sound families with micro-declick envelopes; do NOT align their phases. Continuous sine continues from S01. No impact, bass drop or sound effect for reveals. At 65s allow new quiet S19 electronics ambience.

Sine persists; faint broadcast electronics and two soft original unresolved piano events, with no city ambience. Projection freeze briefly gates noise; move into close paper/glass room sound S20. No fake newscast ident.
S19 electronics recedes; dry paper, modest glass support vibration, two independent close spatial layers and soft inharmonic piano. Keep sine beneath. Paper fold decays toward S21 fabric/key.

Paper archive residual sound fades; two independent quiet breath/fabric pulses, single close brass-metal contact with decay. No clocks/ticking, victorious music or vocal narration. Metal decay leads to S22 dry paper.

S21 key's metal tail disappears into close paper/fingernail friction and HVAC. Original quiet felt-muted piano tone near 1.7s, intentionally off physical hand gesture; distant compute overtone not triumphant. Paper residue J-cuts S23.

S22 paper friction decays; large chamber tone, one honest footstep, a second original electroacoustic resonance later than movement. Old Japan/Europe timbral residue may appear as new one-shots but NEVER restart pre-S18 19/17-second loops. Sine persists into S24.

Bring back new near-market room tone (not restart original seven-second loop), restrained rain, fabric and original four-note idea only as unresolved fragments. At 87.0 simultaneously remove all non-sine sounds, sine continues unchanged into S25. No victory chord.

At 87.000 remove all S24 ambience and motif fragments, preserve only the single sine that began at 0.500 s, phase-continuously. No final chord or spoken years. Finish at 90.000 s with technically de-clicked edit; artistic impression of persistence, not audible digital pop.
